# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (Apr 17, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today, a new feature was added to rotate the Sepolia deputy pause key, and this task was subsequently marked as executed. A new pull request was opened to update a DeputyPauseModule address.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Sepolia Deputy Pause Key Rotation
A new feature was introduced to rotate the Sepolia deputy pause key, specifically for the `DeputyPauseModule`. This task was split from a larger PR to allow for independent execution on Sepolia. The configuration files for this rotation were also added [#1398](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1398). Following its on-chain execution, the task was marked as `EXECUTED` [#1400](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1400).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- A new pull request, [#1401](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1401), was opened to update the `DeputyPauseModule` address in `addresses.toml`.

## CLOSED ISSUES
No issues were closed today.

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were reported today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-node EL Sync Mode Issues
Discussion continues on [#18468](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18468) regarding `op-node` getting stuck in EL sync mode after a restart when reth already has synced data. The latest comment indicates that the issue is being investigated, with a note about Base forking. Previously, a temporary fix suggested changing the sync mode from EL sync to CL sync.

### CrossL2Inbox Gas Introspection
On [#19374](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19374), the discussion revolves around removing gas introspection from `CrossL2Inbox`. The most recent comment clarifies that this is not an urgent issue and does not need to be addressed in preparation for Glamsterdam Defense, as it is not expected to be an issue until Glamsterdam on L2.
